description_en: Start a successfully created Intelligent Contact Robot calling job
description_zh: 启动已创建成功的智能联络机器人呼叫任务
name: StartTask

parameters.description_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling task. You can view it on the [Task Management](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by using the [CreateTask](~~223556~~) API.
parameters.description_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在[任务管理](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)页面查看或通过[CreateTask](~~223556~~)接口获取。
parameters.help_en: The unique job ID of the robot calling task. You can view it on the [Task Management](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list) page or obtain it by using the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html API
parameters.help_zh: 机器人呼叫任务的唯一任务ID。在[任务管理](https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/job/list)页面查看或通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/223556.html接口获取
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.description_en:
Indicates whether to start immediately. Valid values:
- **true**: Yes.
- **false**: No, which means the job will not be started.
parameters.description_zh:
是否立即启动。取值：
- **true**：是。
- **false**：否。代表不启动任务。
